prompt:
Create one clean 3x3 pixel-art mouth atlas for NPC072 in the afraid mood. Use the single attached 3x3 source grid as the exact portrait identity, original lower-half crop, mouth scale and center, jaw, nose base, neck, hair/background registration, palette, and pixel scale reference. Preserve the source muted brown/terracotta lips and warm skin. Add only restrained fear through tense lip corners and slight mouth tension; do not make every pose a grimace, an exaggerated downturned mouth, or a smile. Keep each pose recognizable and faithful to its phoneme shape.

Canvas: seamless three-column by three-row grid, each cell the same complete 64x29 lower-half crop and the overall 64:29 cell aspect ratio. No labels, borders, gutters, margins, extra face panels, text, or decoration. Cell order is A B C / D E F / G H X.

Use these Rhubarb mouth-shape definitions and sounds exactly:
A: Closed lips with light pressure (P, B, M).
B: Slightly open, nearly together teeth; narrow horizontal opening (most consonants, EE).
C: Medium open mouth, relaxed unrounded lips (EH, AE).
D: Wide vertical opening for an open vowel; larger opening than C (AA).
E: Slightly rounded lips; opening no wider than C (AO, ER).
F: Puckered rounded lips, small forward opening; not a tooth bite (UW, OW, W).
G: Upper teeth touch lower lip; not a wide open vowel (F, V).
H: Tongue raised behind upper teeth, opening between C and D; tongue may be invisible at native scale (long L).
X: Closed relaxed idle lips (silence).

Only change expression within the mouth region and preserve the source face registration. Teeth should be muted neutral ivory/gray, distinct from skin, with modest cavity contrast: no warm skin-colored teeth, tooth gaps, bright shiny teeth, lipstick-red lips, excessive black cavity, or large surrounding skin patches. Preserve original lip scale; keep teeth and mouth interiors proportional. Avoid smoothing, antialiasing, blur, or any added content.
